rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Swarm.at provides a settlement protocol for autonomous AI agent workflows across organizational boundaries. It offers a hash-chained, tamper-evident ledger for recording verified agent settlements, trust scoring for agents, revenue-generating blueprint publishing, and framework adapters for LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen. Supports both local stdio transport and a hosted SSE remote endpoint.
